messages:
kai: Hey team — planning a staggered ramp back after parental leave. Plan is 3-day weeks (Tue/Wed/Thu) for 8 weeks starting 2026-07-12. Quick list of asks: 1) will benefits and insurance stay active? 2) how does 401(k) deferral work when hours drop? 3) can we ship a compact monitor + dock to my home? 4) need on-call coverage for production weeks 2-5. 5) is childcare reimbursement prorated? Also need a recurring lactation room slot on Tue mornings.
people-ops: Congrats, @kai! :tada: Please fill the Return-to-Work form: https://hr.redwood.example/return-to-work and pick "staggered ramp" 3-day option. Short answers: benefits continue (premiums prorated if applicable), payroll will apply a temp code PT3D-2026, equipment OK to ship (add address on form), childcare subsidy is pro-rated to your FTE, and we can flag you in the on-call rota so alerts escalate to backup after your shift end.
michelle: Payroll note: 401(k) deferrals are percent-based. If you keep the same percent deferral, the dollar amount will reduce with lower gross pay; we can run a net estimate for you. Equity vesting schedule remains unchanged; compops will email confirmation.
anya: I can cover on-call weeks 2 & 3 and pair with @recruiting for weeks 4 & 5 coverage. Kai, what time zone are you on so I can set escalation windows?
kai: Pacific. Usually online 10:00-16:00 PT those days. Please escalate after 20:30 PT.
people-ops: We'll add this rota snippet you can paste: ```if user.schedule == "staggered" then escalate_after(20:30 PT)``` and a visual reduced-hours badge.
recruiting: Opening a 0.2 FTE contractor req to handle async PRs and paging runbook updates. ETA to shortlist ~2 weeks. Tagging people-ops for expedited onboarding checklist.
kai: For lactation room: please reserve Tue 09:00-09:30 for 10 weeks.
people-ops: Reserved Tue 09:00-09:30 for 10 weeks. Locked the calendar and sent invites.
hr-bot: Reminder: submit the Return-to-Work form within 5 business days to guarantee equipment ships before your start date. Typical ship ETA 6-9 business days.
kai: Submitted form and added shipping address + note about expedited ship if possible. Thanks everyone.
people-ops: Received the form. Next steps: michelle to run 401(k) and subsidy estimate, recruiting to post contractor req, people-ops to flag on-call rota + confirm equipment ship date, and lactation room locked. We'll update this thread as items complete.
michelle: I'll DM the estimates later today.
kai: Appreciate it all :heart:
